info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Waitlists-v1-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Waitlist Retrieval API provides access to information about waitlisted tickets for various events. This endpoint allows consumers to query the list of tickets that are currently on the waitlist, facilitating insights into demand and availability. It serves event organizers and ticketing platforms by managing ticket inventory more efficiently and supporting customer engagement strategies. Utilize this API to enhance user experience by keeping customers informed of their waitlist status.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of tickets on the waitlist.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current waitlist of tickets for an event. It provides an updated view of all tickets that are currently reserved but not yet sold, enabling users to manage their ticket purchasing effectively.
